context.claim: One of the six gases has 18 rows against 247 for the rest, so the plain cross-entropy never rewards the model for getting it right and its per-class F1 collapses - which costs a sixth of the Macro-F1 on its own.
context.change: Weight the cross-entropy by the inverse of each class's frequency, so every class contributes the same total mass to the loss.  The rows are not resampled: the rare class's 18 rows keep their own noise.
context.falsifier: If the rare class's per-class F1 does not rise, the weighting did not reach it.
context.expected_effect: The rare class's per-class F1 rises; Macro-F1 rises with it.
context.decision: the hypothesis is confirmed: macro_f1 moved from 0.7358 to 0.7371
